name: Oboro Yachiyo
source:
The head of a [i]hagureoni[/i] clan, the Oboro.

He joined hands with Senkimaru and Nagumo Shuu to achieve their goal, but eventually parted ways with the former after a disagreement. He fought Chitose and Kazuya in the Battle of Sekigahara but lost. Some time later, at the invitation of the protagonist—who had become Princess Yase— he went to the Yase Village and left only a token of gratitude for the invitation, and vanished afterwards.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/toki/fd/chara/#yachiyo]Toki no Kizuna Hanayui Tsuzuri[/url].]
